content:
[H] high | window title bar | Defect: title text "AI Center" is clipped at the top edge, first letter cut off at the window boundary.

[L] high | bottom of window | Defect: a third card ("Detailed diagnostics" section) is cut mid-render at the window bottom edge, showing only a sliver of clipped text.

[S] med | LM Studio settings key/value column | Defect: value column x-position is inconsistent — "AI enabled", "Provider", "Concurrency" values align left of "Chat model" values while values like "(unset)" and "http://127.0.0.1:1234" start further right, creating a ragged shared grid.

[S] med | AI provider record form | Defect: form label column ("Chat model", "Embedding model", etc.) uses a different left inset and label/value gap than the identical fields in the LM Studio settings card above, breaking alignment between the two cards.

[H] med | AI provider record card | Defect: heading "AI provider record (ai_settings)" exposes a raw database table name in the UI, mixing implementation detail with product copy.

[C] med | right half of screen | Defect: entire right ~60% of both cards is empty dead whitespace while all content is crushed into a narrow left column, badly unbalanced.

[S] low | Embedding model input | Defect: placeholder text "(empty — embedding columns stay u…" is truncated with ellipsis inside the field.

[H] low | value styling | Defect: values mix monospace ("(unset)", "120000 ms", "lmstudio") with proportional text ("2") at the same label column, an inconsistent typographic treatment; "120000 ms" should read "120,000 ms" or "120s".

[S] low | Provider row | Defect: "None (no AI provider)" button, "LM Studio" text button, and "not configured" badge are three different visual treatments sitting in one row with uneven gaps.

[C] low | LM Studio settings card | Defect: helper sentence "Start LM Studio locally (default http://...)" is a dense run-on paragraph mixing URL, navigation path, and policy claim at equal weight, reading like debug output.

[S] low | window edge | Defect: content inset from left edge is very small and inconsistent with the wide top tab bar inset, no shared grid.

VERDICT: unprofessional — clipped title, cut-off card at the bottom, exposed table names, and a lopsided left-packed layout make this read as a debug panel, not a product screen.
